fields.Name: Lists.Refresh.DefaultCron
fields.Comments: Cron expression a list's refresh routine gets when the owner turns on Refresh automatically. The default runs daily at 2:00 am. Each routine copies the value when it is created, so changing it later leaves existing routines alone.

fields.Name: Lists.Refresh.DefaultTimezone
fields.Comments: IANA time zone a list's refresh routine runs its cron in. Each routine copies the value when it is created, so changing it later leaves existing routines alone.
